programs.note: Prompts posted Monday. Poems posted Friday.

house.houseCaption: The Virgilio Writers House of Camden
house.nickCaption: Nick Virgilio (1928–1989) was a Camden poet who, after finding haiku in 1962, gave his life to the form and helped shape American haiku.
